title: Fatigue, Quality of Life, Cognitive Function and Physical Ability in Patients Suspected of Colorectal Malignancy
brief_summary: The aim is to investigate if iron deficiency at the time of colorectal cancer diagnosis has an influence on fatigue, quality of life, cognition and physical ability.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients in whom endoscopy has raised suspicion of colorectal malignancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* non fluent in Danish language
* cerebral impairment (ex severe dementia) so that informed consent can not be obtained
